donationsTitle.message: You keep Quantum Highlighter PRO free and alive

donationsText.message: Hi! I'm George, the creator and sole developer behind Quantum Highlighter. My promise is and always will be that this tool is free and of the highest quality. There's no big company behind it, just countless hours of work and the dream of creating something truly useful for you. To keep innovating, I need your help.

oneTimeDonationTitle.description: Title for the 'buy me a coffee' card.

oneTimeDonationDescription.message: Each coffee is 5 USD and fuels the next improvements of Quantum Highlighter PRO. Feeling generous? You can pick how many at checkout.
oneTimeDonationDescription.description: Description for the 'buy me a coffee' card (5 USD per coffee, quantity chosen at checkout).

oneTimeDonationButton.message: Of course, I'll buy you a coffee!

remindMeLater.description: Button to remind later for donation.

dontRemindAgain.message: Ok, I promise I won't forget (but don't notify me again)
dontRemindAgain.description: Button to never remind for donation.

remindMeLaterTooltip.message: I will remind you again after 80 more highlights.
remindMeLaterTooltip.description: Tooltip for the remind me later button.

donationThanksTitle.description: Title for the donation thank you message.

donationThanksText.message: That coffee goes straight into making Quantum Highlighter PRO better while keeping it free for everyone. Let's keep building the most useful highlighting tool together!
donationThanksText.description: Text for the thank you message shown after clicking the support button.

securePaymentNote.message: Secure payment via Stripe. Opens in a new tab.
securePaymentNote.description: Small note under the support button: payment handled by Stripe, opens in a new tab.

donateButton.description: Header button that scrolls to the support section.

heroTitle.description: Main title of the welcome page.

heroSubtitle.message: The smartest way to highlight, underline, and take notes on any website.

howItWorksTitle.description: Title for the 'How it works' section.

step1Text.message: Just select any text on a webpage.

step2Text.message: Choose a color and highlight type from the menu that appears.

step3Text.message: Add rich-formatted notes to your highlights.

feature1Text.message: Organize your ideas with a vibrant color palette.

feature2Text.message: Choose between a background highlight or an elegant underline.

feature3Text.message: Use bold, lists, links, and more in your notes.

feature4Text.message: Manage and navigate all your notes in one place.

feature5Text.message: Works perfectly on dynamic sites like ChatGPT.

feature6Text.message: Adjust the extension to your liking from the settings menu.

feature7Text.message: Your notes and settings are automatically synced across all your devices.

ctaTitle.description: Title for the call to action section.

ctaText.message: Go to any webpage, select some text, and start organizing your knowledge.
ctaText.description: Text for the call to action section.

ctaTip.message: Tip: You can open the sidebar at any time using the keyboard shortcut (Ctrl + Shift + H by default) or from the extension icon.
ctaTip.description: Tip for the call to action section.

customAmountText.message: Choose how many coffees at checkout. Thank you!
customAmountText.description: Hint under the amount chips: the number of coffees is chosen at checkout.

sidebarDarkModeLabel.description: Label for the sidebar dark mode switch.

forceSolidHighlightsLabel.description: Label for the force solid highlights switch.

forceSolidHighlightsTooltip.message: If enabled, highlights will always have a solid color, which improves visibility by contrast. If disabled, the color will adapt based on the page's background.
forceSolidHighlightsTooltip.description: Tooltip for the force solid highlights switch.

syncSectionTitle.description: Title of the Google Drive sync section in the settings popup.

syncDisconnectedText.message: Right now, your annotations are saved through Chrome sync, which has a limit of about 100 KB. Connect your Google Drive to sync them across your devices without that limit. Keep in mind that Drive sync only works while you stay signed in.
syncDisconnectedText.description: Explains Chrome sync limits and that Drive sync only works while signed in.

syncConnectButton.description: Button to start the Google Drive sign-in flow.

syncConnectedLabel.description: Fallback label when the account email is unavailable.

syncLastSyncLabel.description: Shows the time of the last successful sync.

syncStatsLine.description: Pages and annotations stored in Drive.

syncPendingLine.description: Number of queued changes not yet uploaded.

syncDisconnectTitle.description: Title of the disconnect confirmation dialog.

syncDisconnectWarning.message: A copy of your Drive annotations will be saved on this device. Until you reconnect, they won’t sync between devices: new annotations and changes will stay on this computer. Your data remains intact in your Google Drive.
syncDisconnectWarning.description: Warning shown before disconnecting Google Drive.

syncDisconnectPendingTitle.description: Title of the unsynced-changes confirmation dialog.

syncDisconnectPendingWarning.message: There are $COUNT$ changes that haven’t been uploaded to Drive. They will be kept in this device’s local copy (and uploaded if you reconnect), but they are not in your Google Drive yet. Continue?
syncDisconnectPendingWarning.description: Warning when disconnecting with changes not yet uploaded.

syncDisconnectDoneTitle.description: Title of the dialog confirming the disconnection.

syncDisconnectDoneText.message: Local copy created: $COUNT$ annotations from $PAGES$ pages.
syncDisconnectDoneText.description: Result of the local copy created on sign-out.

syncCopyFromCacheNote.message: No connection: the copy was created from this device’s cached data and may not include recent changes from other devices.
syncCopyFromCacheNote.description: Note when the local copy was built offline from cached data.

syncQuotaErrorTitle.description: Title when the local copy does not fit in local storage.

syncQuotaErrorText.message: The local copy does not fit in this device’s storage, so you were not signed out. Your data remains intact in Google Drive.
syncQuotaErrorText.description: Explains the sign-out was aborted because the copy does not fit.

syncNeedsReauthText.message: Google Drive access expired or was revoked. Reconnect to resume syncing.
syncNeedsReauthText.description: Shown when Drive access expired or was revoked.

syncReconnectButton.description: Button to re-run the sign-in flow after a revocation.

syncPromoTitle.message: Sync your annotations with Google Drive
syncPromoTitle.description: Title of the one-time promo modal.

syncModalConnect.description: Primary button of the promo modal.

syncModalNotNow.description: Secondary button of the promo modal.

syncModalContinue.description: Primary button to proceed despite a warning.

syncConnecting.description: Button label while the sign-in flow is running.

syncConnectFailedToast.message: Could not connect to Google Drive
syncConnectFailedToast.description: Toast when the sign-in flow fails or is cancelled.

syncGenericErrorToast.description: Toast for an unexpected Drive error.

disclosureTitleNew.message: How Quantum Highlighter PRO handles your data
disclosureTitleNew.description: Title of the data-practices notice shown the first time (welcome page, in-page notice, sidebar, panel).

disclosureTitleUpdate.message: This update changes how your data is handled
disclosureTitleUpdate.description: Title of the data-practices notice after an update that changed the practices.

disclosureIntroNew.message: Plain and short, before you make your first highlight:
disclosureIntroNew.description: Intro line of the first-time notice.

disclosureIntroUpdate.message: Version $1 changes what the extension stores or where. In short:
disclosureIntroUpdate.description: Intro line of the update notice. $1 = practices version.

disclosurePracticesHeading.description: Heading of the list describing what is stored and where.

disclosureItemWhere.message: All of it stays in your browser, where Chrome may sync it with your Google account. Google Drive sync is optional and only starts if you connect it yourself.

disclosureItemControl.message: You can edit, export or delete everything at any time from the sidebar and the All annotations panel.

disclosureChangeTitle.message: New annotations also keep the page title, so the All annotations panel can label each page.

disclosureLink.description: Link to the full privacy policy.

panelPrivacyNoteSync.message: Your annotations are stored in your browser and synced by Chrome with your Google account. Nothing is sent to the developer.
